title: PEARL Task Spec v1
description: Declarative submission format for a PEARL task. Enforces Constitution Article 2 (exactness requires a verifier) and Article 5 (side effects require idempotency).

id.description: Stable task identifier, used to derive idempotency keys.

version.description: Spec revision. Required so a task shape change is never silent.

task_type.description: Routing key into the Config Resolution chain (Article 10).

precision_class.description: p0 deterministic, p1 generative-but-verifiable, p2 partially verifiable, p3 subjective. Omit to let the Precision Decision Engine classify.

exactness_required.description: True when the business requires exact confirmation.

deterministic_generation.description: True when the output itself is produced mechanically.

deterministic_verification.description: True when a Machine Verifier can decide correctness. If exactness_required is true and this is false, auto-complete is blocked (Article 2).

capability.description: Capability id to execute. Resolved against the Capability Registry.

payload.description: Opaque input handed to the capability.

assurance.description: Verification steps that must pass before VERIFIED_SUCCESS (Article 4).

side_effects.description: Declared external effects. Each requires an idempotency key template (Article 5).

timeout_seconds.description: Hard execution ceiling. Required by the workflow timeout CI check.

allOf.description: Article 2: exactness_required with no deterministic_verification must declare assurance, otherwise the task cannot auto-complete.
